breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The agent's generated specification correctly identifies that the problem requires periodic boundary conditions and makes no mention of the incorrect Dirichlet condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
